contents: the weights of a 3-member GRU ensemble (33038 weights) and the per-head calibration offsets
model_kind: per-pitch causal GRU (hidden size 32) over the main model's fine confidences, one step per 20 ms frame for each of 64 pitches (MIDI 28 to 91), with two logistic heads: the immediate estimate of the current frame and a revised estimate of the frame 8 frames (160 ms) earlier
runtime_decision: Compiled into the DSP module and evaluated once per analysis frame with fixed weights; nothing is trained or adapted at run time.

architecture.inputs_description: 0.25 times the logits of the five fine cells and of their maximum, the summed maximum confidence of all 88 pitches divided by 8, and 0.25 times the maximum logits of the pitches -24, -19, -12, -7, -1, +1, +7, +12, +19 and +24 semitones away
architecture.head_input: head logit = bias + weights . hidden state + history weight * the pitch's maximum logit at the head's frame

ensemble_rule: p = mean over members of sigmoid(head logit); display probability = p / (p + (1 - p) * exp(-c)) with the head's calibration offset c

calibration.rule: per head, the offset with the highest F1 on the calibration fold subject to a false-positive frame rate on Groove no higher than the previous production model

training_parameters.inputs: fine confidences of the shipped main model on the training clips

validation.metric: note-frame F1 on the four pitched development sets, song bootstrap B=2000

training_exclusion: The held-out test lists were not used for training, calibration or selection.
